blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Weekly clean-up drives in schools and barangays are being pushed in Mandaue City as the local government intensifies efforts to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and prevent dengue. City Councilor Raul Kevin Flores Cabahug urged the Mandaue City Health Office, Department of Education-Mandaue City Division, the city’s 27 barangays, and other concerned agencies to strengthen dengue prevention measures through a resolution the city council passed during its session on Monday, November 23. He announced that an emergency meeting will be held on Tuesday afternoon, November 24, at the Mandaue City Hall. All barangay captains and healthcare workers expected […]...
